rdfs:label: allValuesFrom
rdfs:comment: On an OWL Restriction, asserts that every value of the constrained property must be an instance of a given class — a universal quantifier.
notes: Reads as "for all values on this property, the value is in this class." Common pattern: defining a class of `Person`s whose `knows` relations are *only* with other `Person`s. Pairs with `someValuesFrom` (existential — at least one value is in the class). Vacuously satisfied by a subject with no values for the property — it does not require any value to exist; combine with someValuesFrom or minCardinality for that.

examples.title: A class restricting knows-targets to People

history.note: Notes: allValuesFrom is vacuously satisfied when there are no values.
